title: SupremeAI Guardian Evaluation
description: Data contract for the CI Guardian's automated Pull Request evaluation: the four check categories, weighted scoring, the deterministic PASS/HOLD/REJECT verdict, the autonomous merge-eligibility threshold, and structured healing instructions. BN: CI গার্ডিয়ানের PR-মূল্যায়ন চুক্তি — মানদণ্ড, স্কোর, রায় ও স্বয়ংক্রিয় নিরাময়-নির্দেশনা।

schema_version.description: Contract version. MAJOR bump = verdict vocabulary or category set changed; MINOR bump = additive fields only.

target.description: The exact PR state that was evaluated. Evaluations are bound to an immutable head SHA — a new push invalidates every prior evaluation.

head_sha.description: Evaluated commit. Merge decisions MUST re-verify this still equals the PR's current head (fail-closed on drift).

contract_version.description: Cross-repo parity marker of the evaluation contract.

checks.description: Exactly the four standard categories — one entry each, so verdicts are comparable across PRs and repos.

score.description: Weighted aggregate. overall = sum(category score × category weight) / 100, rounded down.

threshold.description: The configured autonomous-merge eligibility threshold. PASS below it still requires a human/bot fix cycle.

verdict.description: Deterministic outcome — derived, never assigned by taste. Rules are SSOT'd in docs/GUARDIAN_EVALUATION.md.

verdict_reasons.description: Machine-referencable reasons for the verdict (one per decisive rule fired).

merge_eligibility.description: Autonomous-merge gate. eligibility = (verdict == PASS) AND (overall >= threshold) AND (no category is security_scan with status fail).

reasons.description: Non-empty when eligible=false — each entry cites the blocking rule.

healing_instructions.description: Automated healing list — mandatory when verdict is HOLD or REJECT; each instruction is independently actionable by a coder agent.

checkCategory.description: The four standard evaluation categories. template_adherence = PR body/commit-message contract (summary, refs, closing keyword placement); scope_boundary = diff stays inside declared Touching Files and protected paths are untouched; test_evidence = 3-tier verification present and reproducible; security_scan = secret/boundary scanning clean.

status.description: pass = criterion met; warn = met with documented reservations (never blocks alone); fail = criterion unmet (blocks).

weight.description: Relative weight in the overall score; the four weights sum to 100.

details.description: Human-readable explanation of what was observed.

evidence.description: Pointers the verdict can be re-derived from (log lines, file paths, check-run ids). No secrets.

instruction.description: Single, concrete fix step (the HOLD_AND_FIX list format).

automatable.description: true = a coder agent can execute it without human judgement.
